card.name: Powers of ten and orders of magnitude
card.fires_on: The digit right after "10" in scientific notation (the exponent, such as 1 in 10 15 or 8 in 10 8), and the word "orders" before "of magnitude". Seen in vector genome or viral particle doses and in computing or science text.
